review_text: After sips sala, ended up here in January 18. Around 5pm. Left at 6:30pm. People are going in so yeah some peak hours. We still got a seat next to the charging ports. Compared the menu from the current reviews. Ordered the ₱200 hot Matcha Americano in 12oz cup and ₱200 Chic Ala King. Why can't you just call the Matcha Americano an usucha? It's the same thing. Yah, you will receive 6oz Matcha Americano if you choose the hot option. The meal with the chicken tenders was nice. From what I looked over from the counter, I saw that the matcharista was refilling the Matcha canister and the packet had a recognizable supplier. I think it was Perfols Kyo Shizuku. Confirm na lang with the matcharista named Oyu who happened to also be a matcharista of Maa Humble Table. I do think the club must update their menu. Otherwise, this is what they are sticking to.

Food: 4.2/5 We ordered varying drinks and I liked most of them (including their matcha even though I'm not a fan). Although I observed that the sizes of the drinks vary depending on the variety (matcha are served in smaller cups) which may be because of different costs. Service: 4.5/5 Nothing out of ordinary and they accomodated us well throughout the ordering processess. Atmosphere: 3.6/5 The design/furniture/arrangement of the cafe is different from the usual coffee shops nearby and I am not used to it. This is more of a personal preference (not to undermine Fiend's own style) but I would like to sip my coffee on slightly more comfy chairs and not bare metal tables.

one of the best matchas in davao for me, although shouldv'e ordered their specialty ones instead of the plain latte lang to get my money's worth talaga (recommend the banana or biscoff!). still a great drink, very umami and walang bitter aftertaste. more spacious compared to their obrero branch, although medyo mahirap makafind ng seats if 5 or more people kayo :,)

I love how cozy the place is. A touch of gen z and steel maximalist aesthetic but everything is so cohesive. i tried their caramel sea salt and it was definitely not what i expected. it exceeded!! i love it so much! probably my most fave caramel sea salt. would love to have it again! :)
Cool and cozy atmosphere. Food portion is worth the price. Offers a unique variety of coffee and matcha options. Check out their veggie chip nachos 😁👍
one of the coziest cafés I’ve been to! loved the coffee, especially the banana foam latte 😋 their matcha is also definitely worth trying! perfect spot to chill or catch up with friends ❤️

Hello Fiend Obrero. Good day! I would like to share my dining experience last Sunday, June 21, 2026. The food and service were excellent, especially the Sea Salt Coffee and the Aglio e Olio, which is my wife's favorite. One small area for improvement would be the approachability of the staff member wearing eyeglasses. Perhaps it was just my perception, and I may have misread the situation. Nevertheless, the overall dining experience was great, and the quality of both the food and service was outstanding. We had a great time and were very satisfied with both the food and service. I would definitely recommend this coffee shop to my friends and family, and I look forward to visiting again in the future.

I went here 3 times now and the place, staff and vibes are all nice. It's usually crowded so I just ordered for takeout. Drinks are great! Sometimes it's a 3/5, sometimes it's a 5/5, so it really depends on you and your preferences. Since the place is usually full and noisy, I don't think it's great for people looking for something peaceful and quiet. I honestly feel they should take out the "slow bar" thing on their counter as their café is more consistent with the "coffee club" branding where groups of people connect and hang out. Will probably come back to try more of their drinks!

The place has a chill and comfortable vibe, a great spot to hang out with friends. Prices are reasonable, and I was satisfied with my coffee. However, I did notice that the comfort room uses a chain bolt lock, which felt a bit unusual. Just something to consider for improving the overall experience. UPDATE!! They’ve updated the comfort room lock! Kudos to the team for listening to feedback and making improvements. It’s little things like this that make the place an even better spot to hang out.
A great place to just chat, chill, and coffee (matcha if you please). I loved the toy cars and wall arts.

I ordered their Milky Rosy and Fiended Matcha. The Milky Rosy wasn’t as milky as I expected at first, but it did have a strong, distinct flavor. The Fiended Matcha leaned a bit bitter for my taste, but still enjoyable for those who like a stronger matcha profile. For food, we had the Chicken Ala King and Buffalo Chicken Tenders — both were so good and came in huge servings! The place is spacious, perfect for groups, and has a lovely ambiance with well-thought-out interiors.

Obrero. I’ve also visited this branch, and the experience there was completely different. The food was good, the ambiance was nice, and the customer service was good. That’s why I was surprised by the service I received at this branch. I hope the same level of hospitality can be maintained across all branches because consistency is what keeps customers coming back.
I ordered Pistachio Foam Caramel, and it was taste great. Probably one of the best cafe offering pistachio drink.

Very limited parking but once you’re in it’s packed with students. Only one barista juggling order taking and drinks prep. Multiple attempts for GCash payment still wouldn’t go through so I sent it to an account instead. Yeah, call it frustrating. Plus, I was holding the line. Menu rates though are on the budget-friendly side. Almost a month in operation. One visit. Yet, one delicious coffee. So, when the crowd eases up a bit, I would love to swing by for the ‘bites’.
Love the vibe of this coffee shop! I ordered Houjicha Espresso and cajun fries. Coffee was great - smooth and classic. Decent coffee, well brewed, get energized and ready to go.
Coffee and matcha were great, but hospitality and service? Please improve. The staffs don't even greet and say thank you. 🤷🏻 ♀️

Drinks are on the sweeter side and the ambiance is nice. But the staff and baristas at the counter aren’t very friendly or welcoming. Been there couple of times but they always seemed uninterested and not very accommodating. One time, they were busy talking to each other and forgot to call me when my drink was ready. Please improve your customer service.

It's called Café Club. A small café with friendly service. I asked for a proper cup because, as a coffee lover, I never drink coffee or cappuccino from plastic or paper-plastic hybrid cups. But they only have plastic. It's not just bad taste, it's downright criminal for the environment. Nobody who loves coffee wants to drink it from a plastic cup. Perhaps people don't realize that paper cups are also made of 40% plastic and, like almost all disposable cups, can't be recycled. They end up in the ocean or in waste incineration plants, producing toxic fumes. With more than 60 billion disposable cups and sachets in the Philippines alone, that's the largest share of any country in the world. And the bad taste is an added bonus.

will never get tired of fiend. perfect place for a nightcap. love their matcha, open til late, bugnaw ang aircon, great atmosphere, daghan saksakanan. the staff might be getting sick of me because i spend so much time there lol.
The matcha here tastes good! 10/10!
Great food, nice ambiance, and friendly staff. I really enjoyed my visit and will definitely come back! ☕✨

Went there around 4pm. There were lots of people dining. Asked the person by the counter about their matcha menu. The guy and the girl were pushing each other as who will be the one to explain, as if no one wants to explain their menu. Nevertheless, the order was served quickly, but the matcha was 2/5.
This coffee shop serves really good coffee and has such a nice and relaxing place to hang out.
Great coffee, owner is very friendly and accomodating.
LAMI KAAYO ILANG RICE MEALS!! We are visiting from abroad and we tried the Honey garlic beef and Buffalo chicken tenders
THEIR MANGO STICKY RICE IS THE BESSTTTT MUST TRYYYY
Very nice coffee and food!
Seeing is believing!
Their matcha pistachio is SOOOO GOOD, recently went to their Juna branch and let me say that their atmosphere is very nice. Their food is also good
Matcha is good, but bad customer service.
Good drinks and ambiance, highly recommended!

I’ve been to both branches and honestly, the service is consistently bad. The cashiers and staff act like they don’t want to be there and have zero sense of customer service. It’s a shame because it happened at both locations, so it seems like a staff-wide issue. Really hope management handles this.

Went here as it was recommended by youngster cousins who used to tambay during friday and saturday nights. Cool place! Many Gen-Z’s and cafe was packed with people coming in. All of us ordered coffee. The barista said they used arabica but after tasting we insisted to add extra shots of espresso for our drinks as it didnt taste strong. 😔

For matcha lovers, try some matcha drinks, especially some hojicha, they are delicious, also some coffee drinks are delicious 😁 and the food is okay, the taste and serving are also average, the pricing is the same as in coffee shops and the place is very Instagrammable, cozy/retro vibe. Lastly, the owner is accommodating 😊👍
The owner is very kind
The matcha is so good!
The food is okay, the problem is the service is too slow and the staff is not approachable 🥹
